bank.name: Prophets of Islam
bank.subject: Islamic Studies
bank.description: The lives and stories of the prophets mentioned in the Quran.

questions.prompt: Who is the first prophet of Islam according to Islamic belief?
questions.explanation: Prophet Adam (AS) is regarded as the first human and first prophet.

questions.prompt: Which prophet built the Ark to save believers from the flood?
questions.explanation: Prophet Nuh (AS) built the Ark by Allah's command and carried pairs of animals and the believers.

questions.prompt: Which prophet was swallowed by a whale?
questions.explanation: Prophet Yunus (AS) was swallowed by a great fish and prayed from its darkness; Allah saved him.

questions.prompt: Which prophet was betrayed and thrown into a well by his brothers, then rose to power in Egypt?
questions.explanation: Prophet Yusuf (AS) was thrown into a well by his brothers and later became Egypt's treasurer.

questions.prompt: Which prophet received the Torah (Taurat)?
questions.explanation: The Taurat (Torah) was revealed to Prophet Musa (AS).

questions.prompt: Which prophet received the Zabur (Psalms)?
questions.explanation: The Zabur (Psalms) was revealed to Prophet Daud (AS).

questions.prompt: Which prophet received the Injeel (Gospel)?
questions.explanation: The Injeel (Gospel) was revealed to Prophet Isa (AS).

questions.prompt: Which prophet was given the miracle of speaking to animals and commanding the wind?
questions.explanation: Prophet Sulaiman (AS) understood the language of birds and ants and controlled the wind.

questions.prompt: Which prophet is known as 'Ruhullah' (the Spirit of Allah)?
questions.explanation: Isa (AS) is called Ruhullah because he was created by the Spirit (Jibra'il) at Allah's command.

questions.prompt: Which prophet was patient through severe illness and is the symbol of patience (Sabr)?
questions.explanation: Prophet Ayyub (AS) endured severe illness and loss with extraordinary patience.

questions.prompt: Which prophet was sent to the people of Thamud, who cut mountains?
questions.explanation: Prophet Salih (AS) was sent to Thamud, whose miracle was the she-camel.

questions.prompt: Which prophet was sent to the people of Midian (Madyan)?
questions.explanation: Prophet Shuaib (AS) warned the people of Madyan against fraudulent trade.

questions.prompt: Which prophet was sent to the people of Sodom (the people of Lut)?
questions.explanation: Prophet Lut (AS) was sent to Sodom to warn against immorality.

questions.prompt: Who is the father of Prophet Yusuf (AS)?
questions.explanation: Yaqoob (AS), also called Isra'il, was the father of Yusuf (AS).

questions.prompt: Which prophet was the father of Prophet Yahya (John)?
questions.explanation: Prophet Zakariyya (AS) was granted Yahya (AS) in his old age.

questions.prompt: Which prophet is mentioned in the Quran as having been raised to a high place by Allah?
questions.explanation: Idris (AS) is described as raised to a lofty station (19:57).

questions.prompt: Which prophet was commanded by Allah to sacrifice his son, and was ransomed with a great sacrifice?
questions.explanation: Prophet Ibrahim (AS) was tested with the command to sacrifice his son; Allah ransomed him — commemorated at Eid-ul-Adha.

questions.prompt: Prophet Isma'il (AS) and his mother Hajar are associated with which Makkah landmarks?
options: Safa & Marwah and the Zamzam well
questions.explanation: Hajar ran between Safa and Marwah seeking water, and the Zamzam well sprang for Isma'il (AS).

questions.prompt: Who helped rebuild the Kaaba with Prophet Ibrahim (AS)?
questions.explanation: Ibrahim (AS) and Isma'il (AS) raised the foundations of the Kaaba (2:127).

questions.prompt: Which prophet was given the miracle of making a camel come out of the rock?
questions.explanation: Prophet Salih's (AS) she-camel was a miracle for the people of Thamud.

questions.prompt: Who interpreted the dream of the king of Egypt about seven cows?
questions.explanation: Yusuf (AS) interpreted the dream of seven fat and seven lean cows.

questions.prompt: Which prophet was tested with severe loss of wealth, children and health?
questions.explanation: Prophet Ayyub's (AS) patience through trials is proverbial in Islam.

questions.prompt: Which prophet is mentioned as the 'good news' to Zakariyya (AS)?
questions.explanation: Zakariyya (AS) was given glad tidings of Yahya (AS) in his old age.

questions.prompt: Which prophet received the 'Table' (Al-Ma'idah) from heaven for his disciples?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Ma'idah (5:112-115) narrates the heavenly table for Isa's (AS) disciples.

questions.prompt: Which prophet is known for the 'Ship' (Safinah) of Nuh carrying the believers?
questions.explanation: Nuh's (AS) ark saved the believers from the great flood.

questions.prompt: Which prophet's people worshipped the calf during his absence?
questions.explanation: While Musa (AS) was on Mount Tur, the Samiri made a calf for his people to worship.

questions.prompt: Which prophet prayed for the conversion of his entire people and was granted patience?
questions.explanation: Nuh (AS) called his people for centuries with remarkable patience.

questions.prompt: Which prophet was a carpenter by profession?
questions.explanation: Zakariyya (AS) worked as a carpenter, as mentioned in hadith.

questions.prompt: Which prophet had the miracle of iron being made soft for him?
questions.explanation: Allah softened iron for Daud (AS) to make armour (34:10-11).

questions.prompt: Which prophet had a ring and ruled over jinn and wind?
questions.explanation: Sulaiman (AS) commanded the wind and the jinn by Allah's power.

questions.prompt: Which prophet is called 'Zabihullah' (the one of sacrifice)?
questions.explanation: Isma'il (AS) is called Zabihullah for the sacrifice commanded of Ibrahim (AS).

questions.prompt: Who was the grandfather of Prophet Musa (AS)?
options: Levi (son of Yaqoob) lineage — Musa descended from Yaqoob (AS)
questions.explanation: Musa (AS) descended from Yaqoob (AS) through Levi's lineage.

questions.prompt: The Quran was revealed to which prophet?
questions.explanation: The Quran was revealed to Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).

questions.prompt: Which prophet healed the sick and revived the dead by Allah's permission?
questions.explanation: Isa performed these miracles with Allah's permission.

questions.prompt: Which prophet's people were destroyed by a great flood?
questions.explanation: Nuh's people perished in the flood.

questions.prompt: Which prophet is known for his wisdom and just rule?
questions.explanation: Sulaiman was granted wisdom and a mighty kingdom.

questions.prompt: Which prophet was sent to the people of Sodom?
questions.explanation: Lut (Lot) was sent to Sodom.

questions.prompt: Which prophet was the son of Prophet Dawood (AS)?
questions.explanation: Sulaiman was the son of Dawood.

questions.prompt: Which prophet had a twin brother Harun (AS)?
questions.explanation: Harun was Musa's brother and supporter.

questions.prompt: Which prophet is known as the 'seal of the prophets'?
questions.explanation: Muhammad (PBUH) is the seal of the prophets.

questions.prompt: Which prophet is mentioned in the Quran as a carpenter's son?
questions.explanation: Isa is the son of Maryam, raised by a carpenter.

questions.prompt: Which prophet's wife was punished for disbelief?
questions.explanation: The Quran mentions the wives of Nuh and Lut as examples of disbelief.

questions.prompt: Which prophet argued with a tyrant about the sun rising from the east?
questions.explanation: Ibrahim debated Nimrod about the sun.

questions.prompt: Which prophet was granted the ability to make a cup that predicted events?
questions.explanation: Yusuf used the cup in the Egyptian king's court.

questions.prompt: Which prophet's nation was punished with a mighty wind?
questions.explanation: The Aad were destroyed by a violent wind.

questions.prompt: Which prophet's people were punished with a shout (Sayhah)?
questions.explanation: Thamud was destroyed by a mighty shout.

questions.prompt: Which prophet is described as 'the most truthful' (Siddiq) in the Quran?
questions.explanation: Yusuf is called Siddiq in the Quran.

questions.prompt: Which prophet's mother was Maryam (AS)?
questions.explanation: Maryam was the mother of Isa.

questions.prompt: Which prophet is known as 'Habibullah' (the Beloved of Allah)?
questions.explanation: Muhammad (PBUH) is honoured with the title Habibullah, the beloved of Allah.

questions.prompt: Which miracle involved the hand of Musa (AS) shining white?
options: The staff turning to a serpent
questions.explanation: Allah made Musa's (AS) hand shine white as a sign to Pharaoh (Surah Ta-Ha).

questions.prompt: On which mountain did Musa (AS) receive the tablets?
questions.explanation: Musa (AS) received the tablets on Mount Tur (Sinai) after his forty-day seclusion.

questions.prompt: Who raised Musa (AS) in his palace after he was found in the river?
questions.explanation: Pharaoh's wife Asiya persuaded Pharaoh to keep the baby, so Musa (AS) was raised in the palace.

questions.prompt: Which prophet defeated Goliath (Jalut) with a sling?
questions.explanation: The young Dawud (AS) felled Goliath with a sling in the battle against the Philistines.

questions.prompt: Which prophet interpreted the dreams of the king's two imprisoned servants?
questions.explanation: In prison, Yusuf (AS) interpreted the dreams of the cupbearer and the baker.

questions.prompt: Which prophet was the son of Ishaq (AS)?
questions.explanation: Yaqoob (AS), also called Israel, was the son of Ishaq (AS).

questions.prompt: Who was the father of Ismail (AS)?
questions.explanation: Ismail (AS) was the eldest son of Ibrahim (AS) from Hajar.

questions.prompt: Which prophet was thrown into the fire by his people but was saved by Allah?
questions.explanation: When Ibrahim (AS) was thrown into the fire, Allah commanded it to be cool and safe for him.

questions.prompt: Which prophet called his people to Allah for nine hundred and fifty years?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Ankabut says Nuh (AS) remained among his people for nine hundred and fifty years.

questions.prompt: Who was the wife of Ibrahim (AS) and mother of Ismail (AS)?
questions.explanation: Hajar was Ibrahim's (AS) wife and the mother of Ismail (AS).

questions.prompt: Who was the wife of Ibrahim (AS) and mother of Ishaq (AS)?
questions.explanation: Sarah was the wife of Ibrahim (AS) who gave birth to Ishaq (AS) in old age.

questions.prompt: How were the people of Lut (AS) destroyed?
questions.explanation: Allah rained stones of baked clay upon the towns of Lut's (AS) people.

questions.prompt: How many prophets are mentioned by name in the Quran?
questions.explanation: Twenty-five prophets are named in the Quran.

questions.prompt: What does 'Ulul Azm' mean?
options: The resolute prophets who endured great trials
questions.explanation: Ulul Azm refers to the messengers of firm resolve who faced the greatest opposition.

questions.prompt: What does 'Rasul' mean in Islamic terminology?
options: A messenger sent with a new scripture or law
questions.explanation: A Rasul is a messenger commissioned with a new revelation and law for his people.

questions.prompt: Which statement about 'Nabi' and 'Rasul' is correct?
options: Every Rasul is a Nabi, but not every Nabi is a Rasul
They are identical in every respect
A Nabi is higher than a Rasul
questions.explanation: Every Rasul is also a Nabi, but a Nabi is not necessarily a Rasul with a new law.

questions.prompt: The Quran mentions the 'Suhuf' (scrolls) of which two prophets?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-A'la refers to the scrolls of Ibrahim and Musa.

questions.prompt: Which prophet tended sheep before receiving prophethood?
questions.explanation: Musa (AS) worked as a shepherd in Madyan before prophethood.

questions.prompt: Which prophet spoke in the cradle as a baby?
questions.explanation: As an infant, Isa (AS) spoke to defend his mother Maryam (AS).

questions.prompt: What does 'Hawariyyun' refer to?
options: The disciples and helpers of Isa (AS)
questions.explanation: The Hawariyyun were the sincere disciples who supported Isa (AS).

questions.prompt: How many disciples (Hawariyyun) did Isa (AS) have?
questions.explanation: The Quran and tradition refer to the twelve disciples who aided Isa (AS).

questions.prompt: Which prophet was raised up to heaven by Allah?
questions.explanation: Allah raised Isa (AS) to Himself; he was neither killed nor crucified.

questions.prompt: Which prophet is called 'Al-Masih' (the Messiah)?
questions.explanation: Isa (AS) is called Al-Masih in the Quran.

questions.prompt: The Arab tribes trace their lineage to which prophet?
questions.explanation: The Arabs of the Adnanite line descend from Ismail (AS), son of Ibrahim (AS).

questions.prompt: Bani Israel are named after which prophet?
questions.explanation: Yaqoob (AS) is also called Israel, and his descendants are Bani Israel.

questions.prompt: According to Islamic tradition, who was the first of the Messengers (Rusul)?
questions.explanation: Nuh (AS) is traditionally regarded as the first messenger sent with a law.

questions.prompt: Which prophet had twelve sons from whom the tribes of Israel descended?
questions.explanation: Yaqoob (AS) had twelve sons whose descendants formed the tribes of Israel.

questions.prompt: In the valley of ants, which prophet heard the speech of an ant?
questions.explanation: Surah An-Naml tells of Sulaiman (AS) hearing an ant warn its colony.

questions.prompt: Who was the father of Ibrahim (AS)?
questions.explanation: Ibrahim's (AS) father Azar was an idol-maker mentioned in the Quran.

questions.prompt: Ibrahim (AS) was born in which region?
questions.explanation: Ibrahim (AS) was born in the land of Babylon (Ur), where people worshipped idols.

questions.prompt: Which prophet forgave his brothers when they came to him in Egypt?
questions.explanation: Yusuf (AS) forgave his brothers, saying there was no blame upon them.

questions.prompt: Which prophet is called 'Zul-Nun' (the one of the fish) in the Quran?
questions.explanation: Yunus (AS) is called Zul-Nun because of his stay in the belly of the great fish.

questions.prompt: Which dua did Yunus (AS) make in the darkness of the fish?
options: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin
Rabbi inni lima anzalta ilayya min khairin faqir
questions.explanation: Yunus (AS) called out that there is no god but Allah and that he was of the wrongdoers.

questions.prompt: The people of which prophet avoided punishment by believing before it came?
questions.explanation: The people of Yunus (AS) believed at the last moment and were spared the punishment.

questions.prompt: Which prophet traveled with Al-Khidr to learn wisdom?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Kahf recounts Musa's (AS) journey with Al-Khidr and its three lessons.

questions.prompt: Allah commanded Musa (AS) to speak gently to whom?
questions.explanation: Musa and Harun (AS) were told to speak to Pharaoh in gentle words.

questions.prompt: At the burning bush on Mount Tur, who received the call of Allah?
questions.explanation: On his journey from Madyan, Musa (AS) saw a fire at Tur and received the divine call.

questions.prompt: Musa (AS) married the daughter of which prophet?
questions.explanation: While in Madyan, Musa (AS) worked for Shuaib (AS) and married one of his daughters.

questions.prompt: Who was the first prophet to receive revealed scriptures (Suhuf)?
questions.explanation: Tradition holds that Adam (AS) received ten scrolls as the first revealed scriptures.

questions.prompt: Which prophet is described in the Quran as 'an excellent example' for those who hope in Allah?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Ahzab (33:21) declares the Prophet (PBUH) an excellent example for believers.

questions.prompt: Who was the king to whom Musa (AS) was sent?
questions.explanation: Musa (AS) was sent to Pharaoh, the tyrant of Egypt.

questions.prompt: Which prophet will lead mankind with the 'great intercession' (Shafa'ah al-Uzma) on Judgment Day?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) will be granted the great intercession on the Day of Judgment.

questions.prompt: Which name of the Prophet (PBUH) is mentioned in Surah As-Saff?
questions.explanation: Surah As-Saff (61:6) mentions the Prophet (PBUH) by the name Ahmad.

questions.prompt: Which prophet is known for weaving chainmail armor?
questions.explanation: Allah taught Dawud (AS) the making of coats of mail (Surah Al-Anbiya).

questions.prompt: Which prophet's people were the builders of the city of 'Iram'?
questions.explanation: The Quran mentions Iram, the city of pillars associated with the people of Aad.

questions.prompt: Which prophet asked Allah for Harun (AS) as a helper?
questions.explanation: Musa (AS) asked Allah to strengthen him with his brother Harun (AS).

questions.prompt: Which prophet is associated with the 'cave' story in Surah Al-Kahf alongside Al-Khidr?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Kahf recounts Musa's (AS) journey with Al-Khidr.

questions.prompt: Which prophet's mother placed him in a basket on the river?
questions.explanation: Musa's (AS) mother set him adrift in a basket on the Nile to save him from Pharaoh.

questions.prompt: Which prophet is mentioned in the Quran as being 'saved from the sea' with his army drowned after him?
questions.explanation: Musa (AS) and his followers crossed the sea while Pharaoh's army drowned.

questions.prompt: Which prophet is known as the one given 'the two bright proofs' (staff and white hand)?
questions.explanation: Allah granted Musa (AS) two clear signs: the staff and the shining hand.

questions.prompt: Who was the uncle and protector of Musa (AS) among his own people?
questions.explanation: Harun (AS), Musa's brother, was his supporter among Bani Israel.
